message: The other day, I was in the middle of a family video call when my phone decided it was time to take a nap—right in the midst of my grandson's latest antics. I scrambled to find my charger, but it made me think about how often we rely on our gadgets. It’s a good reminder to keep some important documents and maybe even a backup plan handy, just in case technology has other ideas. Have you ever had a tech hiccup at the worst time?
